study_note: Six reward-only-critic prior backbones, one seed (55). Four automatic-alpha cells match the SAC prior parameterization study at seed 55, changing only the active outer critic target to reward_only: clip/smooth log-std mappings on [-10, 2] crossed with joint post-tanh entropy targets -21 and -10.5, automatic alpha initialized at 1. Two additional cells use fixed actor alpha=0.0001, one per mapping; their retained target_entropy and ent_coef_lr are inactive. The fixed alpha matches the numerical TD-MPC2 coefficient but not its regularization strength because this study uses corrected post-tanh entropy and no Q normalization. Comparing fixed and automatic alpha includes their different initial temperatures and early training schedules. All cells retain mean-pair actor Q and min-pair target Q, native random initialization from scratch, stochastic prior collection, full diagnostics, 2 million decisions and 80 checkpoints every 25,000 decisions. Inner optimization and MPPI remain off; dormant inner settings do not define an approved inner-handoff recipe. Only the four automatic-alpha cells isolate critic entropy against existing SAC controls. The manifest does not override alg_params.
